gloss: grove of trees; stand of trees

definitions.gloss: grove of trees; stand of trees; clump of trees
definitions.explanation: A group of trees standing together. Evokes a picturesque, somewhat literary image of trees clustered in a landscape.

examples.japanese: {木立|こだち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Light streams in through the trees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{木立|こだち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A small house surrounded by a quiet grove of trees came into view.

notes:
Composed of {木|こ} (tree, an older form of ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧) + {立|だち} (standing). Has a literary, scenic quality and frequently appears in descriptions of landscapes, gardens, and rural settings. Unlike ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (forest), {木立|こだち} suggests a smaller, more open cluster of trees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木立|こだち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ — among the trees
- {木立|こだち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧ — the shade of the trees
- {木立|こだち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ — surrounded by a grove of trees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ — woods; a smaller area of trees than a forest
- ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ — forest; a larger, denser area of trees
- ⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧ — row of trees; trees planted in a line along a road
